name: MakeInspires STEAM Summer Camp Pleasantville
description_short: Two late summer weeks of MakeInspires STEAM camp for ages 5 to 15, held at the Addie-Tude Cultural Arts Center in Pleasantville, in age groups of up to six with dedicated instructors. Half day morning or afternoon, or full day 9:30 to 3:30, with an engineering challenge every Friday afternoon.
notes: Partial weeks allowed if they start on a Monday and run at least 3 days. Registration closes 9:30 am the Sunday before each week. Campers aged 14 get 25% off and 15 get 50% off as CITs; sibling discounts applied automatically. Catered lunch is an add on. No price is printed on this page.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Pleasantville STEAM Summer Camp 2026 page: 2 weekly sessions August 17th to 28th, half day 9:30 to 12 or 1 to 3:30, full day 9:30 to 3:30, ages 5 to 15, at Addie-Tude Cultural Arts Center, 42 Memorial Plaza, Pleasantville, NY (no ZIP). Subject descriptions on the page are labeled 2025, so no activities are recorded.
